title: Find where the fire was stopped
lead: A fire spread across a field. Some squares were firebreaks, so the fire could not cross them. The numbers tell you when the fire arrived. Your job is to find the firebreaks.
pictureLabel: A small solved puzzle: the fire starts at a yellow spark and goes around two black firebreaks

lesson.title: Learn by doing
lesson.body: The lesson shows you on a small board, one step at a time. It takes 2 minutes and has no clock.

rules.title: The rules
rules.spark: The fire starts at the yellow square, the spark.
rules.spread: Every minute it moves one square up, down, left or right. Never diagonally.
rules.number: A number is the minute the fire reached that square.
rules.breaks: Firebreaks are squares the fire cannot cross. The board tells you how many there are.
rules.burn: Every other square must burn. You have solved it when every number is right.

tap.title: How to tap
tap.once: Tap a square once to place a firebreak.
tap.twice: Tap it again for a dot. A dot is your own note that says: no firebreak here.
tap.thrice: Tap a third time to clear the square.
tap.check: When your last firebreak is in place, the game checks the board for you.
tap.help: Made a mistake? Press Undo. Stuck? Press Hint.

tips.title: Tips
tips.count: Count the steps from the spark to a number. If the number is bigger, something blocks the short way. Look for the firebreak there.
tips.neighbours: Two squares side by side never burn more than 1 minute apart.
tips.closedIn: No square may be closed in. If firebreaks wall off a square, the fire cannot reach it, and that is not allowed.
tips.colours: The colours show time. Yellow burned first, violet burned last.
tips.noHurry: There is no hurry. In Practice you can pick a size with no clock.
